verdict.rationale: The only evidence touching official SDKs is Stripe's own llms.txt, which tells AI agents to check npm for the latest version of 'Stripe packages'. That implies first-party installable libraries exist, but nothing in the pack names, documents or describes SDK coverage for Connect. The CLI and MCP probes are different capabilities and are not credited here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDKs and their supported languages, Connect-specific SDK usage examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: When installing Stripe packages, always check the npm registry for the latest version
